metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: Apple, Marathon Petroleum, Palantir, Lufthansa

content.text:
LIVE
Updated 5 min ago
Stocks to Watch: Apple, Marathon Petroleum, Palantir, Lufthansa
↘️ Marathon Petroleum (MPC): Shares of the petroleum refiner slipped. Fellow oil refiner CVR Energy (CVI) agreed to pay $4.2 billion to buy two refineries from Marathon. The company also reported that its profit surged during the third quarter.
↘️ Apple (AAPL): The iPhone maker’s shares slipped. The new CEO John Ternus warned of weakening profit margins thanks to high memory costs in an earnings call on Monday.
↘️ Palantir (PLTR): The data-analysis company reported soaring quarterly profit, but its shares slid about 5%, reflecting investor worries over its ability to sustain its growth.
